title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller
Location: Rochdale
Salary: £28,000 - £32,000 per annum
Hours: Monday to Friday - 35 hours per week
Contract: Permanent, Full Time
Working Pattern: Office Based

Client Details

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Credit Controller to join a growing team based in Rochdale.

As a Credit Controller, you will support the day-to-day Credit Control function, helping to ensure outstanding debts are managed effectively and payments are received on time.

Description

The key responsibilities of a Credit Controller will be:
- Assisting with the management of a shared inbox and providing day-to-day support to the Credit Control function.
- Assessing client credit status and ensuring appropriate credit limits are set and maintained.
- Proactively managing overdue accounts and carrying out effective debt recovery procedures.
- Following up with customers regarding outstanding payments and resolving queries where required.
- Building and maintaining positive customer relationships to support timely payment and ongoing business.
- Producing regular reports on receivables, outstanding debts and overdue accounts for senior management.
- Working closely with the wider finance team to support cash flow forecasting and minimise credit risk.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring all credit control activity is completed efficiently and in a timely manner.

Profile

A successful Credit Controller will have:
- Previous experience in credit control or accounts receivable.
- A self-motivated and proactive approach.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Excellent problem-solving abilities.
- Strong numerical skills with excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confident using Microsoft Excel
- The ability to work effectively as part of a team while also working independently.
- Excellent organisation and time management skills.
- The ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Job Offer
- £28,000 - £32,000 salary
- Generous annual leave
- Free on-site parking
- Discounted health plan available
- Company discounts
- Permanent, full-time employment
- 35 hours per week
- A supportive office-based working environment

title: Finance Assistant / Sales Ledger
company: WHITAKER SMITH RECRUITMENT LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Finance Assistant / Sales Ledger

Based: Bury (hybrid working 2-3 days in the office after training)

Salary: £30k-£35k + benefits including private healthcare, enhanced pension

Bury £30,000 - £35,000 Hybrid working

Whitaker Smith are exclusively working with a fantastic growing SME in Bury looking to recruit a Finance Administrator / Finance Assistant into their small finance team.

This is a varied, hands-on role with a real focus on invoicing, data and Excel reporting. Around 70% of the role will initially involve raising sales invoices and working with large spreadsheets, alongside supporting the wider finance team wherever needed

Role:
- Raising and processing sales invoices through Xero
- Working with large Excel spreadsheets and data sets
- Using VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables and SUMIFS to manipulate and reconcile data
- Supporting purchase invoice processing when required
- Bank and other finance reconciliations
- Assisting with reporting and general finance administration
- Getting involved across the finance function wherever additional support is needed
- Supporting Financial Controller with analysis for month end and new business ventures when required

We are looking for someone who is comfortable working independently and enjoys getting into the detail with the initiative to help out when required. You will need good Excel skills and previous experience of raising invoices is essential.

This role will start off a couple of weeks in the office for training then only require 2-3 days in the office each week so you must be confident in your ability & able to work autonomously

Please send your CV for immediate consideration!
